hooks.name: Auto GitHub Sync
hooks.description: 코드/문서 파일 저장 시 GitHub 변경을 먼저 받은 뒤 add → commit → push

action.command: cd 'c:\Users\lee\Downloads\sejong-prj'; $cred = 'credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential'; git -c $cred fetch origin -q; git add -A; git diff --cached --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git commit -q -m ('auto: sync ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')) }; git -c $cred pull --rebase -q origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git -c credential.helper= -c $cred push -q origin main } else { git rebase --abort; Write-Output 'sync: rebase conflict, push skipped' }
